name: Hidden death saves
author: Alexandria
summary: The DM rolls death saving throws in secret, so the table never knows how close a friend is.

rules.text: When a character is dying, the **DM rolls their death saving throws in secret** and tracks the result. The players only learn the outcome when the character stabilizes, wakes or dies. A Medicine check (DC 10) reveals whether they are stable.

assistant.dm: Death saves are rolled by the DM in secret here. Record them with death_save, but do not reveal successes or failures to players; tell them only stable, awake or dead. A DC 10 Medicine check reveals stable or not.
assistant.player: At this table the DM rolls death saves in secret, so do not guess how close a dying character is. A DC 10 Medicine check tells whether they are stable.
